tool: Ghidra 12.1.2; existing RE-VM project; read-only analysis
method: Direct selected-entry walks under the retained NDS32 BE-instruction/LE-data premise. Skipped callees and computed callbacks are limitations, not audited bodies.

scan_state.behavior: Selected SET_CHANNEL path passes band base and channel to tuning and advances toward passive LISTEN without checking its return. Completion alone does not prove tuning success.

tuning.behavior: Writes channel metadata before an internal return-value failure branch. The selected failure path returns zero before storing the completed band-base cache. Other selected successful and cached-identical paths return one.

read_query.behavior: Ordinary address query branch loads one 32-bit word without a target write, copies address and value to a 16-byte event and preserves the command sequence. Special prefixes and the set branch have different effects and are prohibited.

whitelist.meaning: four bytes: fixed override, requested channel, center channel, bandwidth

public_source.contract: CMD_ID_ACCESS_REG query, CMD_ACCESS_REG address/data pair, EVENT_ID_ACCESS_REG reply

limitations: Words are non-atomic software state; matching band and channel do not establish RF tuning, dwell, reception, frame validity or a peer.
No complete writer or callback audit; stale/unchanged cache may predate the scan.
Queries add bounded event traffic and perturb scan timing; missing replies are inconclusive.
No firmware execution, Gemian scan, register write or hardware test was performed in this analysis.
